title: feat(clone): clone say shows status while it waits on a slow box
description:
## the gap

on a loaded box, `rhx clone say` prints naught while it waits. for a 9s `ss -xp` the cli is silent for ~14s (the auth gate, then the observe loop), and up to ~29s when the transcript is slow to rise. before #678 that box printed a deny at ~10s; now the say lands, but the human sees no status in the meantime (`rule.require.status-feedback`).

## the shape of the fix

- a status line on stderr once the dispatch has waited past a short threshold (e.g. 3s): `⏳ the clone is slow to answer — its peer-cred scan is in flight`
- a second line once `delivered` arrives and the observe loop starts, so the two waits read apart

## evidence

- found in review of the #678 fix (`.behavior/v2026_11_01.fix-clone-auth-lookup-timeout`, fulcrum F12)
